# Star planets printed by the Vishwavidyalaya Panchang 2022-23 (Kameshwar
# Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University), at its misramana: 30 ghatis and
# half the day after sunrise, the local apparent midnight that ends the
# date (46|54 on 14 July 2022). Read from the page images in the Internet
# Archive item `vishwavidyalaya-panchang`; the print's R-shaped numeral is
# a 1 (C1229 a).
#
# Columns: civil date; T on a Thursday, the days the print computes, else
# -; then Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn as
# sign|degree|minute|second, sidereal. Read by
# crates/siddhanta/tests/mithila.rs (docs/03-design/makaranda.md §4,
# C1227, C1280, C1281).
#
